# `flatMapToTap`

Suggests Effect.tap when a flatMap or andThen callback runs an effect and returns its unchanged parameter

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377144` |
| Language Service name | `flatMapToTap` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/flat-map-to-tap` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

interface User {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
}

declare const findUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<User>
declare const auditUser: (user: User) => Effect.Effect<void>

export const loadUser = (id: string) => findUser(id).pipe(
  Effect.flatMap((user) => auditUser(user).pipe(Effect.as(user)))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(flat-map-to-tap): `Effect.tap` expresses this observation more directly than `Effect.flatMap` with a manual re-yield.
*/
)
```
